V. 13.
Therefor• I ſpeak to them in parables, becauſe ſeeing they ſee not
〈◊〉 In Purſuance of this general Rule, I do not give more Knowledge 〈◊〉 this People, becauſe they uſe not that which they have. •lready: ••aving all the Means of ſeeing, hearing, and underſtanding, they 〈◊〉 none of them; they do not effectually ſee, or hear, or underſtand any Thing.
